name: solidaria
description: Campanha de doação solidária para apoio a uma atleta — monorepo (frontend, backend, pacote compartilhado)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run test --workspace=apps/api && npm run test --workspace=apps/web
